QuestInfo.name: [Astra Secondary Weapon] Ancient God or Crafty Cat?
QuestInfo.0: Neinheart says Gardin and Ollie arrested a cat...thing? Anyway, there's something fishy going on with the cat-thing. Speak to Gardin and Ollie about the case.
QuestInfo.1: Speak to Gardin and Ollie about the case and the cat-thing's identity.
QuestInfo.2: The cat thing, Erion, confidently declared Archelon would be able identify his weapons as Erion originals from their outline alone. Neinheart decided to cross-examine Archelon in Arcus to test this claim.
